questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not enter.
One-way.
Stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop Sign Ahead.
Side Road.
Railroad Warning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop Sign Ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: You drive defensively when you:

options.text: Put one car length between you and the car ahead.
Look only at the car in front of you while driving.
Keep your eyes moving to scan for hazards ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your eyes moving to scan for hazards ahead.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means looking ahead down the road for dangers. Staring only at the road in front of your car is unsafe. Scan ahead and stay aware of vehicles around you.

questions.question: At intersections with a Yield sign, you must:

options.text: Yield to traffic that could create a conflict.
Yield only to vehicles on your right.
Always slow down but keep going without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to traffic that could create a conflict.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, you must slow down or stop if needed and give the right-of-way to other vehicles. Yield to any crossing or merging traffic that is close enough to be a hazard.

questions.question: If your car is about to be hit from behind, which should you NOT do?

options.text: Apply your brakes.
Let go of the steering wheel.
Press your head against the head restraint.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let go of the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If hit from behind, your body will be thrown backward. Press yourself firmly against your seat and keep your head on the head restraint to prevent whiplash. Keep a firm grip on the steering wheel and be ready to brake to avoid hitting another vehicle.

questions.question: If you do not see a gap in traffic to enter the freeway, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and force other drivers to make room.
Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap.
Stop at the end of the ramp to wait for a gap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap.
questions.explanation: If you do not see space in traffic to enter the freeway, slow down on the ramp to wait. Do not drive to the end of the ramp and stop, as you will not have enough room to speed up to match traffic before entering.

questions.question: When you approach an intersection with a flashing red light, you must:

options.text: Stop completely, yield to traffic and pedestrians, then go.
Slow down and drive carefully.
Stop and stay stopped until the light is no longer red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, yield to traffic and pedestrians, then go.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Come to a full stop and go only when it is safe.

questions.question: When you approach an intersection with a flashing red signal, you must:

options.text: Stop completely, yield to traffic or pedestrians, then go.
Slow down and drive carefully.
Stop and stay stopped until the light is no longer red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, yield to traffic or pedestrians, then go.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light the same as a stop sign. Stop completely, yield to oncoming traffic or pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: In bad weather, you should:

options.text: Steer off the road.
Drive in a low gear.
Steer and brake smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer and brake smoothly.
questions.explanation: In bad weather, avoid hard braking and sharp turns. These actions make it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; curving road ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: You are driving behind a motorcycle and want to pass. What must you do?

options.text: Stay in the right lane because the motorcycle is small and does not use all of the lane.
Blow your horn to make the motorcycle move to the shoulder so you can pass.
Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before you pass and while you pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before you pass and while you pass.
questions.explanation: When passing a motorcycle, give it a full lane. Do not share the same lane with the motorcycle. If you return to your lane too soon, the rider may swerve right into traffic or off the road.

questions.question: When a school bus is picking up or dropping off children, what must you do?

options.text: Stop, no matter which direction you are traveling.
Stop only if you are traveling in the same direction.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, no matter which direction you are traveling.
questions.explanation: When a school bus is picking up or dropping off children, you must stop completely. This applies no matter which direction you are traveling.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, what should you do?

options.text: Brake lightly.
Do not use the brakes.
Brake hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not use the brakes.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, do not brake. Braking will make the skid worse.

questions.question: When should you give up your right-of-way?

options.text: Often, even at controlled intersections.
Whenever it helps prevent crashes.
Never. It confuses other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Whenever it helps prevent crashes.
questions.explanation: Do not assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way. Give up your right-of-way whenever it helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: You have a green light but traffic is blocking the intersection ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Turn left and find another route.
Wait and do not enter the intersection until traffic clears.
Follow other vehicles and enter the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait and do not enter the intersection until traffic clears.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if traffic is blocking your way, even if the light is green. If you enter and get stuck when the light turns red, you will block cross traffic. You can get a ticket for blocking an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A railroad crossing is ahead. Be ready to stop.
You will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is ahead. Be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, and listen. Be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
Pedestrians must not cross here.

questions.correctAnswerText: A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that pedestrians may cross ahead. If a pedestrian is in the crosswalk, you must stop and stay stopped until they have crossed.

questions.question: You see a steady yellow traffic light ahead and have not entered the intersection yet. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to cross before the red light.
Slow down and carefully go through the intersection.
Stop safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop safely.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection, cross as quickly as you can.

questions.question: When entering a freeway, how should you check for traffic?

options.text: Use your rearview and side mirrors.
Use your rearview mirror only.
Use your side mirror and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your side mirror and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: When entering a freeway, use your side mirror and look over your shoulder. This helps you see all traffic and merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, where should you turn?

options.text: Into any lane.
Into the first lane.
Into the second lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Into the first lane.
questions.explanation: When you turn, move from your current lane into the first available legal lane. When turning from a two-way street to a one-way street, turn into the first lane.

questions.question: When are streets and highways most slippery?

options.text: When it has been raining hard for several hours.
When they are clean and dry.
Just after it starts to rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: Just after it starts to rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery in the first half hour of rain. Water mixes with oil and chemicals on the road that have not washed away yet. Drive with extra caution on slippery roads.

questions.question: When stopped at double railroad tracks, when may you proceed?

options.text: When there are no trains approaching on either track.
As soon as one train has passed.
Only when the train is out of sight.

questions.correctAnswerText: When there are no trains approaching on either track.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, wait until the passing train is far down the track before proceeding. Another train may be coming on the second track, hidden by the passing train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
No U-turns.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what traffic laws they must follow. When you see this sign, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turn.
No turning.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Stop sign ahead.
Divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction you cannot turn. The arrow points right, which means no right turns are allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Yield to all traffic before crossing the intersection.
Stop, then enter the intersection when it is safe to do so.
Slow down and cross the intersection carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and cross the intersection carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down to a safe speed and cross the intersection with caution.

questions.question: If you are under 21, your license can be suspended if you drive with a blood alcohol level of:

options.text: 0.15 percent or more.
0.08 percent or more.
Any amount.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any amount.
questions.explanation: Drivers under 21 cannot drink and drive at all. Any trace of alcohol in your system will result in serious penalties, including a two-year license suspension.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
The road narrows ahead.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves back and forth.

questions.question: If a child is about to run into the street, what should you do?

options.text: Start to prepare to slow down.
Flash your headlights.
Sound a sharp blast of your horn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sound a sharp blast of your horn.
questions.explanation: Use a short, loud horn blast if a child or pedestrian is about to step into the street in front of your car.
